days.title: Weak Topic Focus: Generative AI Concepts Deep Dive

activities.description: Deep dive into Generative AI core definitions, taxonomy, and how GenAI differs from traditional AI and machine learning.
Scenario-based practice exercises classifying AI workloads and identifying suitable Generative AI use cases.

days.title: GenAI Concepts Reinforcement & Introduction to LLMs

activities.description: Spaced review and flashcards covering GenAI concepts, capabilities, and common business applications.
Targeted practice questions distinguishing discriminative vs generative models and problem-solving scenarios.
Introduction to foundation models and how Large Language Models power modern generative applications.
Study Transformer architecture fundamentals, self-attention mechanisms, and the training lifecycle.
Practice quizzes on transformer components and the differences between pre-training and fine-tuning.
Learn prompt engineering concepts, zero-shot/few-shot learning, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning approaches.
Prompt design exercises and scenario questions on choosing between prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and RAG.
Mid-point cumulative review of GenAI foundational concepts and common misconceptions.
Exam-style practice set focusing on GenAI concept definitions and boundary cases.
Review of LLM architectures, fine-tuning tradeoffs, and prompt strategies.
Study Google Responsible AI principles, ethical challenges, and recognizing algorithmic bias in generative models.
Evaluate case studies identifying potential harms, biases, and ethical issues in GenAI deployments.

days.title: Responsible AI Governance and Safety Controls

activities.description: Learn implementation of safety filters, content moderation, watermarking, and model governance policies.
Practice configuring safety threshold parameters and auditing GenAI systems for compliance.
Explore Vertex AI Studio features, prompt design interface, and foundational model catalogs.
Hands-on practice designing prompts and adjusting inference parameters such as temperature, top-k, and top-p.
Learn model output evaluation metrics, comparing foundational models, and operationalizing prompts in Vertex AI.
Scenario practice selecting models and tuning parameters for specific business use cases in Vertex AI Studio.
Targeted review of difficult GenAI concepts, terminology, and foundational exam patterns.
Timed quiz addressing GenAI concept scenarios and business value drivers.
Review Responsible AI principles, safety filters, and governance checklists.
Final review of Vertex AI Studio tool capabilities, prompt testing, and parameter selection.
Full mixed-topic mock assessment with concentrated coverage on GenAI concepts.
Final summary review of LLM architecture and model customization strategies.

planning_notes: The schedule was adapted to replan the remaining 11 days of the original 14-day study journey following the completion of the first 3 days. Diagnostic tracking identified 'genai_concepts' as a critical weak area for this beginner-level student, with no topics marked as strong. To address this, the plan prioritizes 'genai_concepts' immediately on Days 1 and 2 with dedicated learning and practice, followed by spaced review and reinforcement sessions on Days 5, 10, and 11. The other core domains (llm_architecture, responsible_ai, and vertex_ai_studio) are sequentially introduced with structured learning, practical exercises, and review to ensure comprehensive exam readiness while strictly respecting the 90-minute daily ceiling.
